title: 20-second UFO sighting the same day

tellings.quote: a dramatic UFO sighting right in front of us.

plain: On the same day as other events at Skinwalker Ranch, a Utah ranch known for reports of strange happenings, a UFO showed itself for about twenty seconds, according to Brandon Fugal, the ranch's owner. He tells Michels it was "a dramatic UFO sighting right in front of us," seen by him and the people with him, at some point since he bought the ranch in 2016.
